title: Night of the Living Candy
synopsis: The candy zombies are back, but this time they aren't hungry, they're just really bored.
plot:
A failed decorpsinator experiment reanimates the Candy Graveyard again. Bubblegum locks down the kingdom and Finn and Jake arm up for a repeat of the last two outbreaks. But the zombies do not attack. They shuffle into town, sit down on benches, and sigh. One of them asks a Banana Guard if there is anything to do.

Bubblegum, baffled, runs tests. The serum worked halfway: the zombies have their minds back but no appetite, no purpose, and an infinite amount of time. They are the most bored creatures in Ooo. Starchy tries to organize them into a militia and they decline because it sounds like effort.

Peppermint Butler solves it. He has been looking for staff for the night shift for years. The zombies are hired as the Candy Kingdom's overnight crew: polishing floors, sorting archives, and listening to Starchy's radio show, which finally has an audience. Bubblegum declares the outbreak resolved. The zombies ask for a break room. She builds them one.
transcriptText:
Princess Bubblegum: Lockdown! Everybody inside! Finn, Jake, the graveyard's up again!
Finn: Zombie rules! Don't get bit, don't let 'em in, don't—
Jake: Yeah yeah, we know the drill.
[The candy zombies shuffle into the square. They sit on a bench.]
Candy Zombie 1: [sighs]
Candy Zombie 2: [sighs]
Banana Guard: Uh. Are you gonna... attack?
Candy Zombie 1: Is there anything to do around here?
Banana Guard: ...What?
Candy Zombie 2: Like, a hobby. Or a thing.
[The lab.]
Princess Bubblegum: The serum worked. Halfway. They've got their minds back. But no hunger. No drive. No... anything.
Finn: So they're not dangerous?
Princess Bubblegum: They're bored, Finn. Terminally bored. Forever.
Jake: That's worse.
[The square. Starchy stands on a box.]
Starchy: Zombies! Join the Candy Militia! Rise up!
Candy Zombie 1: Rising up sounds like a lot.
Candy Zombie 3: Do we have to stand?
Starchy: YES.
Candy Zombie 3: Pass.
Peppermint Butler: Princess. A word.
Princess Bubblegum: Pep, I'm in the middle of—
Peppermint Butler: I have been requesting night staff for eleven years.
Princess Bubblegum: ...Go on.
Peppermint Butler: [to the zombies] Can you polish a floor?
Candy Zombie 2: Slowly.
Peppermint Butler: Perfect.
[Night. Zombies polish the throne room. Starchy's radio plays.]
Starchy: [on the radio] —and THAT'S why the moon is a hologram—
Candy Zombie 1: Turn it up.
Princess Bubblegum: Outbreak resolved. Also, apparently, we have a night shift now.
Candy Zombie 3: We'd like a break room.
Princess Bubblegum: [writing] Break room. Fine.
